input.title: Give the Topic select an accessible name that matches its visible label
input.rationale: The <select id="topic"> has no accessible name. A visible "Topic" label sits just before it on line 11, but that label has no for attribute and doesn't wrap the select, so they aren't linked. I can only edit the select itself, so this patch adds aria-label="Topic". That matches the visible label text, which keeps it consistent for speech-input users. A better fix in the source would be to add for="topic" to the <label> on line 11. That links the two directly and also lets users click the label text to focus the select. If you make that change, remove this aria-label. This patch should clear this finding, but it doesn't make the page compliant. Please check with assistive technology.
